Flood Insurance Data

Privacy Policy

Last updated October 22, 2026.

What we collect

Flood Insurance Data is a static reference site. We do not ask for personal information, and there are no accounts, sign-ups, or forms. Visits are counted with Google Analytics (see below). Our host (Cloudflare) processes standard server request logs (such as IP address and user agent) to serve the site and protect it from abuse; see Cloudflare's privacy policy for details.

Analytics and cookies

We use Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages are read. It sets cookies in your browser, and Google receives your IP address, the pages you view and basic device details. We see totals, not who you are. You can opt out with Google's opt-out add-on or by blocking cookies in your browser. If advertising is added in future (see below), the cookies and vendors involved will be disclosed here before they are enabled.

Advertising

The site currently shows no ads. If advertising is added, it may be served by Google, including Google AdSense. Third-party vendors such as Google use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on visits here and elsewhere. You may opt out of personalized advertising via Google Ads Settings, and review other options at aboutads.info. This section will be updated to name every ad vendor at the time ads are enabled.

Third-party data & links

All figures are compiled from public U.S. federal sources (FEMA OpenFEMA and the FEMA National Risk Index). We link to official FEMA pages; their privacy practices are their own. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by FEMA.

Children & changes

The site is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their information. We may update this policy; material changes will be reflected by the date above.
